announcements.headline: EQS-News: GRAMMER AG publishes results for the first nine months of 2026
announcements.insight: GRAMMER AG publishes results for the first nine months of 2026. This follows earlier H1 and Q2 updates, providing a consolidated view of earnings performance through October.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: GRAMMER AG: Difference in earnings performance in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the previous year and update to the earnings forecast for full-year 2026
announcements.insight: Grammer AG revises its full-year earnings forecast following significantly above-target second-quarter results. This update signals a change in guidance after the initial half-year publication.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: GRAMMER AG publishes results for the first half of 2026
announcements.insight: GRAMMER AG publishes results for the first half of 2026. This follows an earlier adhoc stating Q2 earnings were significantly above previous levels.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: GRAMMER AG: Earnings in the second quarter of 2026 significantly above the previous year´s level
announcements.insight: Grammer AG reports earnings significantly above the previous year. This positive performance update suggests improved operational results for shareholders.
